verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents searchable in-app libraries for built-in capabilities, tools, MCP servers, Actions, and Skills, which users can add to agents from the Agent Builder (docs-45, docs-14). MCP servers can also be added at runtime from the MCP Settings panel without editing config or restarting (docs-8). Skills are a documented, API-manageable feature (docs-32, gh-2). However, there is no evidence that these libraries are a real, browsable public registry or marketplace, as opposed to a catalog of what is already available or configured in the deployment. missing for 10: evidence of an actual external/community skills or plugins registry, one-command or one-click install from such a registry, hands-on corroboration of the install flow.
